content.value: Let a triangular·facet, tessellated part of a large curved surface, is defined by the vertices $\textnormal { A } ( 1 , 4 , 0 ) , \textnormal { B } ( 5 , 6 , 0 ) , \textnormal { C } ( 4 , 0 , 0 )$ and their vertex normal are $\mathrm { N } _ { \mathrm { A } } = \lnot i + j + 3 k , \mathrm { N } _ { \mathrm { B } } = j + 3 k ,$ $\mathrm { N } _ { \mathrm { C } } = \mathrm { ~ } i + 4 k$ respectively. If the triangle is illuminated by a monochromatic point light source positioned at $( - 2 , 3 , 2 )$ , and the diffuse reflectivity of the surface is 0.7 then find the diffuse reflection intensity of point ${ \mathrm { ~ P ~ } } ( 3 , 3 , 0 )$ that a viewer will see from position $( 6 , 3 , 1 )$ . Assume any missing values (if necessary).
